// Generate table creation payloads for all 4 tables
// Airtable valid colors: blueLight, cyanLight, tealLight, greenLight, yellowLight, orangeLight, redLight, pinkLight, purpleLight, grayLight, blueBright, cyanBright, tealBright, greenBright, yellowBright, orangeBright, redBright, pinkBright, purpleBright, grayBright
// Creators already created (tbl59nWGcoucE0gjf) - skip it
const tables = [
  {
    name: 'Brands',
    fields: [
      { name: 'brand_name', type: 'singleLineText' },
      { name: 'industry', type: 'singleLineText' },
      { name: 'website_url', type: 'url' },
      { name: 'brand_voice', type: 'multilineText' },
      { name: 'style_guide_url', type: 'url' },
      { name: 'logo_url', type: 'url' },
      { name: 'primary_contact', type: 'singleLineText' },
      { name: 'contact_email', type: 'email' },
      { name: 'whatsapp', type: 'phoneNumber' },
      { name: 'slack_channel', type: 'singleLineText' },
      { name: 'clickup_list_id', type: 'singleLineText' },
      { name: 'drive_folder_id', type: 'singleLineText' },
      { name: 'monthly_retainer', type: 'currency', options: { precision: 0, symbol: '₹' } },
      { name: 'services', type: 'multipleSelects', options: { choices: [{ name: 'UGC' }, { name: 'AI Creatives' }, { name: 'Media Buying' }] } },
      { name: 'status', type: 'singleSelect', options: { choices: [{ name: 'Active', color: 'greenBright' }, { name: 'Paused', color: 'yellowBright' }, { name: 'Churned', color: 'redBright' }] } },
      { name: 'onboarded_date', type: 'date', options: { dateFormat: { name: 'iso' } } },
      { name: 'ad_account_id', type: 'singleLineText' },
      { name: 'roas_target', type: 'number', options: { precision: 2 } },
      { name: 'notes', type: 'multilineText' }
    ]
  },
  {
    name: 'Leads',
    fields: [
      { name: 'company_name', type: 'singleLineText' },
      { name: 'contact_name', type: 'singleLineText' },
      { name: 'email', type: 'email' },
      { name: 'phone', type: 'phoneNumber' },
      { name: 'instagram', type: 'singleLineText' },
      { name: 'linkedin', type: 'url' },
      { name: 'website', type: 'url' },
      { name: 'industry', type: 'singleLineText' },
      { name: 'monthly_ad_spend', type: 'currency', options: { precision: 0, symbol: '₹' } },
      { name: 'source', type: 'singleSelect', options: { choices: [{ name: 'Referral' }, { name: 'Instagram' }, { name: 'LinkedIn' }, { name: 'Website' }, { name: 'Cold Outreach' }] } },
      { name: 'stage', type: 'singleSelect', options: { choices: [{ name: 'New', color: 'blueBright' }, { name: 'Contacted', color: 'cyanBright' }, { name: 'Meeting Scheduled', color: 'tealBright' }, { name: 'Proposal Sent', color: 'greenBright' }, { name: 'Negotiating', color: 'yellowBright' }, { name: 'Won', color: 'purpleBright' }, { name: 'Lost', color: 'redBright' }] } },
      { name: 'notes', type: 'multilineText' },
      { name: 'next_follow_up', type: 'date', options: { dateFormat: { name: 'iso' } } },
      { name: 'proposal_url', type: 'url' },
      { name: 'estimated_value', type: 'currency', options: { precision: 0, symbol: '₹' } },
      { name: 'lost_reason', type: 'singleLineText' },
      { name: 'created_at', type: 'date', options: { dateFormat: { name: 'iso' } } }
    ]
  },
  {
    name: 'Invoices',
    fields: [
      { name: 'invoice_number', type: 'singleLineText' },
      { name: 'amount', type: 'currency', options: { precision: 0, symbol: '₹' } },
      { name: 'currency', type: 'singleSelect', options: { choices: [{ name: 'INR' }, { name: 'USD' }] } },
      { name: 'status', type: 'singleSelect', options: { choices: [{ name: 'Draft', color: 'grayBright' }, { name: 'Sent', color: 'blueBright' }, { name: 'Paid', color: 'greenBright' }, { name: 'Overdue', color: 'redBright' }] } },
      { name: 'due_date', type: 'date', options: { dateFormat: { name: 'iso' } } },
      { name: 'paid_date', type: 'date', options: { dateFormat: { name: 'iso' } } },
      { name: 'description', type: 'multilineText' },
      { name: 'month', type: 'singleLineText' },
      { name: 'payment_link', type: 'url' },
      { name: 'notes', type: 'multilineText' }
    ]
  }
];

return tables.map(t => ({ json: t }));
